Both hollowed helpers take `tick`, which is only needed for an event field plus a cadence guard — hence `tick % 4` / `tick % 8` gating (dampen more often than the add-on scoring). Dampen mirrors IntegrateMotion exactly: zero-velocity skip, Vector3.Multiply by 0.9f, trace flag, event with vx/vy/vz (the naming BuildFinalState already uses). The quaternion add-on is minimal and self-contained: constant angle/blend arguments plus entity velocity for the vector-taking methods, one summary event per entity, and it is the only writer of TraceState.UsedQuaternionOps (required by math_expectations, emitted by ReplayRunner). Each Compute* method uses exactly the APIs the auto-generated description lists in the order listed — notably no Vector3.Normalize anywhere, which also avoids NaN when velocity is zero, so JSON serialization of quaternion_score cannot fail. Verified: builds clean (0 warnings), runs 32 ticks, emits all six required event types (366 events), all four trace flags true, identical SHA256 across two runs.
